description: Record immutable WorkflowArtifacts from workflow task runs, expose latest/history/task-run views, and render them in Issue Detail.

tasks.title: Parse task artifact declarations
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-definition/spec.md#Requirement: Task definitions declare workflow artifact capture metadata
tasks.description: Add workflow definition support for task-level artifacts.files metadata and preserve it separately from action with input. Update default workflow YAML to declare proposal, design, tasks, review, self-review, and specs outputs where the workflow should record durable artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow YAML parser preserves artifacts.files paths on task definitions.
Task action input still contains only with data and does not receive artifacts.files.
Default workflow templates declare artifact capture paths for expected planning, review, and spec outputs.
Backend tests prove with.expect.files alone does not create artifact capture metadata.
tasks.output: Workflow task definitions expose artifact capture metadata to runtime and runner work items.
tasks.notes: Keep artifact metadata out of action input; no Snapshot naming.

tasks.title: Support acp-agent marker oneOf
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-agent/spec.md#Requirement: acp-agent marker expectations support oneOf values
tasks.description: Extend mohist/acp-agent expectation handling so marker expectations can target a path and accept any marker listed in oneOf. Preserve existing with.expect.files and with.expect.markers behavior as action-level completion checks only.
acceptanceCriteria: acp-agent accepts marker expectations with path plus oneOf values.
A review output containing either <promise>PASS</promise> or <promise>FAIL</promise> satisfies action completion.
A missing accepted marker keeps the action in the existing ask-again completion flow.
Tests confirm FAIL satisfies action completion but does not alter check verdict semantics.
tasks.output: acp-agent expectation parser and tests support path-scoped oneOf markers.
tasks.notes: Do not infer WorkflowArtifacts from with.expect.*.

tasks.title: Add artifact persistence model
tasks.description: Introduce the small WorkflowArtifact domain fact, WorkflowArtifactRecorded event, pending upload and bound artifact persistence rows, and EF Core migrations/indexes. Keep infrastructure metadata such as storage path, hash, content type, size, and issue linkage in rows/read models instead of WorkflowRun JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain model includes artifact id, workflow run id, task run id, source path, and recorded timestamp.
Persistence supports pending upload rows and bound WorkflowArtifact rows with indexes for workflowRunId, path, recordedAt, and taskRunId.
WorkflowRun JSON does not store artifact content, pending upload status, storage paths, hashes, content types, or file sizes.
No model, table, DTO, route, or UI concept introduced by this task uses Snapshot naming.
tasks.output: Backend domain, rows, DbContext mapping, and migration for WorkflowArtifacts and pending uploads.
tasks.notes: Latest artifact remains a query projection, not a table or domain object.

tasks.title: Implement filesystem artifact storage
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-artifacts/spec.md#Requirement: Artifact content is stored in filesystem-backed artifact storage
tasks.description: Add filesystem-backed artifact storage for immutable file and directory content under generated Mohist data-root paths. Store metadata.json plus content for files and metadata.json plus files/ for directories, and provide read APIs for content and directory entries.
acceptanceCriteria: File artifacts are persisted under generated workflow/task/artifact storage paths with metadata.json and content.
Directory artifacts are persisted as one collection with contained files under files/.
Source artifact paths are never used directly as storage path segments.
Storage tests cover unusual source paths, missing stored content errors, directory file count limits, total size limits, and symlink traversal refusal.
tasks.output: Filesystem artifact storage service with file and directory persistence/read coverage.
tasks.notes: Use generated or sanitized storage segments controlled by Mohist.

tasks.title: Add runner upload endpoint
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Requirement: API accepts runner artifact uploads for workflow work
tasks.description: Expose the internal multipart upload endpoint for workflow work items and store uploads as hidden pending records. Derive task run context from workflowRunId and workId, enforce idempotency by workflow run, work item, task run, and source path, and reject conflicting retries with different content hashes.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/workflow-runs/{workflowRunId}/work/{workId}/artifact-uploads accepts multipart/form-data with source path, content type, content hash, size, and content.
The endpoint returns an upload id for a new pending upload and returns the existing upload id for same-key same-hash retries.
Same-key retries with different content hashes return conflict and preserve original pending content.
Pending uploads do not appear in latest, history, or task-run artifact queries.
tasks.output: Internal artifact upload endpoint and pending upload tests.
tasks.notes: Request metadata must not include attempt; server derives task run from active work context.

tasks.title: Upload artifacts from runner
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-definition/spec.md#Requirement: Declared artifact files are required in the first version; specs/workflow-agent/spec.md#Requirement: Actions may report dynamic artifacts
tasks.description: Update the TypeScript runner to collect declared artifacts.files and dynamic action-produced artifacts from the runner workspace, validate workspace-relative paths, capture files or directory collections safely, upload them before result reporting, and include artifactUploadIds in task results.
acceptanceCriteria: Runner normalizes artifact paths relative to the workspace and refuses paths that escape the workspace.
Runner captures declared file artifacts and declared directory artifacts as required outputs before reporting task results.
Runner uploads captured artifacts using multipart/form-data and reports returned artifactUploadIds with completed or failed task results.
Missing, unsafe, over-limit, or failed declared artifact uploads cause normal task failure instead of completion with warnings.
Runner tests cover declared files, directory collections, dynamic artifacts, path escape refusal, symlink refusal, and upload failure handling.
tasks.output: Runner artifact capture/upload flow with artifactUploadIds in task result reports.
tasks.notes: Directory traversal should not follow symlinks by default.

tasks.title: Bind uploads during result reporting
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run/spec.md#Requirement: Task result binding records produced WorkflowArtifacts
tasks.description: Extend task result DTOs and WorkflowGrain.ReportResultAsync so reported artifactUploadIds are validated against the reporting workflow run and work item, then atomically bound into visible WorkflowArtifact records before task completion becomes visible. Failed task results may bind uploaded diagnostic artifacts, and binding failures should follow structured normal task failure handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Task result/report API accepts artifactUploadIds and passes them into workflow result binding.
Binding validates every upload id belongs to the same workflow run and work item and derives the producing task run from active work context.
All valid uploads bind atomically into immutable WorkflowArtifact records, or none are exposed on structured binding failure.
WorkflowArtifactRecorded emits only after a bound artifact is visible in workflow history.
Tests cover completed task binding, failed task diagnostic binding, foreign upload id rejection, missing required declared artifact failure, and no WorkflowArtifactMissing event.
tasks.output: Workflow result binding records visible WorkflowArtifacts and emits WorkflowArtifactRecorded events.
tasks.notes: Bind before exposing completed task history.

tasks.title: Expose artifact query endpoints
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Requirement: API exposes issue-scoped workflow artifact queries
tasks.description: Add issue-scoped artifact list and content endpoints for latest-by-path, path history, task-run filtering, immutable file content, and directory collection browsing. Resolve the issue's current or recent workflow run and validate artifact ownership before returning content.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /issues/{number}/workflow/artifacts returns the newest bound artifact per path by default.
GET /issues/{number}/workflow/artifacts?path=...&history=true returns all versions for that path in production order.
GET /issues/{number}/workflow/artifacts?taskRunId=... returns only artifacts produced by that task run.
GET /issues/{number}/workflow/artifacts/{artifactId}/content returns recorded artifact content and rejects artifacts outside the issue workflow context.
Directory artifacts appear as one collection in top-level responses and expose contained recorded files through browsing/content responses.
tasks.output: Issue-scoped workflow artifact query/content API with latest, history, task-run, and directory browsing behavior.
tasks.notes: Responses should use WorkflowArtifact or Artifact naming only.

tasks.title: Attach artifacts to workflow history
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run/spec.md#Requirement: Task runs expose produced artifacts in workflow history
tasks.description: Join bound artifact summaries onto workflow history/task-run DTOs without embedding content in WorkflowRun state. Replace empty task artifacts arrays with recorded artifact summaries so repeated task runs expose their own immutable outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow history DTOs include artifact summaries for each task run that produced artifacts.
Artifact links in task history refer to recorded artifact ids and not current workspace paths.
Repeated ai-review task runs each retain their own review.md artifact summary.
Tests prove latest review points to the newest run while older review artifacts remain attached to producing task rows.
tasks.output: Workflow history/read DTOs expose per-task WorkflowArtifact summaries.
tasks.notes: Keep storage paths and content hashes out of workflow domain JSON.

tasks.title: Render issue artifact views
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#Requirement: Issue Detail shows latest WorkflowArtifacts index
tasks.description: Update web API clients and Issue Detail UI to render a compact latest artifacts index and per-task artifact links in the workflow timeline. Opening an artifact should fetch immutable recorded content by artifact id, and directory artifacts should render as one browsable collection.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue Detail renders latest artifacts grouped by path and opens recorded content for the latest artifact version.
Each workflow task row displays artifacts produced by that task run, including historical versions superseded by later runs.
Directory artifacts render as one top-level collection in latest and task artifact views and allow browsing contained recorded files.
UI labels, component names, and DTO usage use Artifact or WorkflowArtifact terminology and not Snapshot terminology.
Web tests cover latest artifact rendering, directory artifact rendering, and per-task artifact history rendering.
tasks.output: Issue Detail latest-artifacts index, task artifact links, immutable content viewer, and directory browsing UI.
tasks.notes: Distinguish recorded artifact content from mutable current-worktree file views.

tasks.title: Verify check-loop artifact preservation
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-artifacts/spec.md#Requirement: Artifact queries expose latest, history, task-run, and content views
tasks.description: Add end-to-end or integration coverage that exercises a check repair loop with multiple ai-review task runs recording the same review.md path. Verify both reports remain accessible from their task rows, path history returns both versions in production order, and the latest query points to the newest review.
acceptanceCriteria: Test workflow records review.md from ai-review.1 and ai-review.2 as separate immutable WorkflowArtifacts.
Task-run filtering returns the correct review.md artifact for each producing ai-review task run.
Path history returns both review.md versions in production order.
Latest artifacts returns only the ai-review.2 review.md version for that path.
Recorded content reads return the stored historical content, not the current workspace file.
tasks.output: Cross-layer check-loop preservation tests for repeated review.md artifacts.
tasks.notes: This task validates the primary user pain point from the issue.
